views_def.fac_day: CREATE VIEW fac_day AS SELECT b.code AS code, s.trade_date AS date, s.d1_sk AS SK, s.d1_sd AS SD, s.d1_sj AS SJ, s.d1_mk AS MK, s.d1_md AS MD, s.d1_mj AS MJ, s.d1_mzk AS MZK, s.d1_mzd AS MZD, s.d1_skxl AS SKXL, s.d1_sdxl AS SDXL, s.d1_mkxl AS MKXL, s.d1_mdxl AS MDXL, s.d1_kon AS KON, s.d1_duo AS DUO, s.d1_linj_dkd AS LINJ_DKD, s.d1_linj_kdk AS LINJ_KDK, s.d1_xp_dkd_nb AS XP_DKD_NB, s.d1_xp_kdk_nb AS XP_KDK_NB FROM stock_daily_feature_snapshot AS s INNER JOIN stock_basic AS b ON ((b.symbol = s.symbol)) WHERE ((s.trade_seq % 1) = 0);
views_def.v_day_qfq: CREATE VIEW v_day_qfq AS SELECT b.code AS code, CAST(s.trade_date AS DATE) AS date, s.d1_open_qfq AS open, s.d1_high_qfq AS high, s.d1_low_qfq AS low, s.d1_close_qfq AS "close", s.d1_volume AS volume FROM stock_daily_feature_snapshot AS s INNER JOIN stock_basic AS b ON ((b.symbol = s.symbol)) WHERE ((s.trade_seq % 1) = 0);
views_def.v_min15_qfq_current: CREATE VIEW v_min15_qfq_current AS SELECT m.symbol, m.trading_date, m.bar_end, m.slot_seq, m.open, m.high, m.low, m."close", m.volume, m.amount, (m.open * COALESCE(d.factor, 1.0)) AS open_qfq, (m.high * COALESCE(d.factor, 1.0)) AS high_qfq, (m.low * COALESCE(d.factor, 1.0)) AS low_qfq, (m."close" * COALESCE(d.factor, 1.0)) AS close_qfq, d.factor_version FROM min15_bar AS m LEFT JOIN adj_factor AS d ON (((d.symbol = m.symbol) AND (d.trade_date = m.trading_date)));
views_def.v_min15_qfq_done: CREATE VIEW v_min15_qfq_done AS SELECT b.code AS code, s.bar_end AS datetime, s.m15_open_qfq AS open, s.m15_high_qfq AS high, s.m15_low_qfq AS low, s.m15_close_qfq AS "close", s.m15_volume AS volume FROM v_m15_complete AS s INNER JOIN stock_basic AS b ON ((b.symbol = s.symbol));
